notes: Weather suitability scoring: add green/yellow/red 10-point weather suitability ratings to both current conditions and each of the 3 forecast days for all weather regions. Scores use location-specific weighting for visibility, cloud cover, wind gusts, precipitation and snowfall; mountain destinations such as Shinhotaka and Hakuba use stricter visibility/cloud thresholds, while Shirakawago allows cloudy/light-snow conditions more generously.
